registered_note: Registered while the P0 batch was generating, before any P0 batch result or any OpenSim evaluation of P0 runs. Development data: the P0 smokes (seed 20, kinematics only)
question: When native ARDY conditioning is given 4 s lookahead and reaches the goals (P0 G4), is the motion also dynamically consistent, and does output-layer correction at the goal window (W0g) carry the dynamic cost E1 found for M2 output corrections
data: Successful P0 runs (config/p0_20261102.json) of arms G0, G4, W0g, G4W x offsets 0.5/1.0 m x 24 tasks x seeds 26-28 (576 runs), read only; no new generation
pipeline: Identical to config/e1_biomech_20261101.json (same model, IK, contact, ground-reaction estimate, inverse dynamics, static optimization, trim 0.5 s, body mass 75 kg); worker python/scripts/run_e1_biomech.py --protocol e2
validity: As E1: IK RMS <= 0.03 m, IK max <= 0.10 m, required vertical force within 1 +- 0.02 BW; invalid runs excluded pairwise. Pipeline valid when every G0 cell has residual force RMS <= 0.03 BW

primary.family: Three hypotheses on the residual force RMS (BW), Holm-adjusted at 0.05 over the exact sign-flip p values; each also requires its interval on the stated side
primary.K1: W0g - G4 > 0: output-layer correction at the goal window carries a dynamic cost that lookahead conditioning does not
primary.K2: G4 - G0 non-inferior with margin +0.03 BW: test of (difference - 0.03) < 0; reaching the goals by native conditioning keeps the motion dynamically consistent
primary.K3: G4W - G4 non-inferior with margin +0.03 BW: adding output correction after lookahead conditioning keeps the dynamic consistency
primary.pooling: One difference per task-seed-offset, pooled over both offsets, equal-weight task means, cluster t interval (G - 1 df), exact sign-flip p

secondary: unsupported fraction (residual > 5% BW), residual moment / BW
RMS and peak hip, knee, ankle and lumbar extension moments (N m/kg)
muscle effort (sum of squared activations), mean activation, reserve RMS and peak
per-offset contrasts W0g - G0, G4 - G0, W0g - G4, G4W - G4
validity by arm and offset; post hoc sensitivity without exclusion and with limb-marker validity, as E1
conventions_not_derived: Non-inferiority margin 0.03 BW (the E1 pipeline-validity threshold); arm subset G0/G4/W0g/G4W (G1/G2 left out to halve CPU time)
estimated_hours: about 12 with 6 OpenSim workers (about 10 min per run, 95% static optimization)
